name: Holmesglen Access Scholarship
summary: Up to $2,000 towards tuition fees for Holmesglen VET students facing financial hardship, disability or other disadvantage.
key: Up to $2,000 per scholarship - to be used for tuition fees only.
who: VET students (Certificate, Diploma, Advanced Diploma) at Holmesglen
Facing financial hardship, disability or other disadvantage
Not eligible for VET Student Loans, FEE-HELP or Free TAFE, and not receiving another scholarship
how: Download and complete the application form from the Holmesglen page, with supporting documents
catches: Committee meets monthly; funds subject to availability

evidence.quote: Up to $2,000 per scholarship - to be used for tuition fees only.
The Scholarship Committee meets monthly to assess applications, and funds are subject to availability.
